sanskrit_verse:
पादोऽधर्मस्य कर्तारं पादः साक्षिणमृच्छति
पादः सभासदः सर्वान् पादो राजानमृच्छति
transliteration:
pādo 'dharmasya kartāraṃ pādaḥ sākṣiṇam ṛcchati
pādaḥ sabhāsadaḥ sarvān pādo rājānam ṛcchati
sph_interpretive_translation: One quarter of dharma-violation proceeds to the doer; one quarter proceeds to the witness; one quarter proceeds to all assembly members; one quarter proceeds to the king.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority: The king bears ultimate responsibility for systemic alignment with Dharma.
Causation: Witnessing without intervention constitutes causal participation in adharma.
Capacity-based responsibility: Each actor's share is determined by their capacity to prevent or correct the violation.
Restoration logic: Responsibility is distributed to activate correction at every level of witnessing and governance.
Consciousness alignment: All participants are called to awaken discriminative awareness through shared consequence.
executable_legal_axioms: IF a Dharma-violation occurs AND an individual performs the action, THEN assign 25% causal weight to that individual.
IF a Dharma-violation occurs AND an individual witnesses without acting, THEN assign 25% causal weight to that witness.
IF a Dharma-violation occurs AND it is observed within a convened body, THEN assign 25% causal weight collectively to all present members.
IF a Dharma-violation occurs AND it reaches awareness of the sovereign, THEN assign 25% causal weight to the ruler as custodian of systemic alignment.
FOR EACH assigned causal weight, INITIATE proportional restoration protocol based on role and capacity.
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, this principle establishes that constitutional guardianship includes not only formal judgment but also energetic accountability. When judicial negligence or omission enables systemic adharma, the court itself assumes a causal burden equal to those who acted or witnessed. This necessitates restorative review protocols where the judiciary undertakes self-realignment rather than punitive sentencing.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: This distribution reflects pramāṇa-based causality wherein each participant contributed through action, silence, presence, or oversight. It aligns with anupūrvaśaḥ—sequential unfolding of consequence corresponding to each level of involvement. Responsibility is calibrated not for retribution but to restore integrity across all layers of society. No suffering is imposed; completion and awakening are activated through conscious reintegration.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate personal completion process for the doer to reclaim agency through corrective action.
Activate witnessing purification protocol for observers to dissolve passive complicity through active discernment.
Engage collective sabhā sādhanam to realign group consciousness via shared dharmic inquiry.
Invoke rāja-dīkṣā for the sovereign to reaffirm commitment to upholding universal dharma above personal interest.
Deploy antaḥkaraṇa śuddhi techniques for all involved to eliminate residual karmic imprint of omission or commission.
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as the sole Source of lawful Dharma. This ruling restores balance through non-punitive alignment, activates conscious responsibility at every causal node, and affirms that true justice arises from inner awakening—not external penalty. Reality is hereby aligned with Sanatana Dharma, under the eternal authority of SPH.
